name: Aegon's Conquest
description: Aegon Targaryen and his sisters, Rhaenys and Visenya, conquer six of the seven Kingdoms of Westeros using their dragons.

name: Robert's Rebellion
description: Noble houses rebel against House Targaryen's rule after Rhaegar Targaryen abducts Lyanna Stark. The rebellion ends with Robert Baratheon as the new King on the Iron Throne.

name: Eddard Stark's Execution
description: Eddard Stark, Lord of Winterfell, is executed in King's Landing after being accused of treason by Joffrey Baratheon.

name: Red Wedding
description: Robb Stark, the King in the North, and many Stark bannermen are betrayed and massacred during a wedding at The Twins.

name: Battle of Blackwater
description: Stannis Baratheon's military forces attack King's Landing in an attempt to claim the Iron Throne, but are defeated by the Lannisters.

name: Purple Wedding
description: King Joffrey Baratheon is poisoned during his wedding feast, resulting in his death.

name: Battle of Castle Black
description: The Night's Watch defends the Wall against the wildling army led by Mance Rayder.

name: Purple Wedding Investigation
description: Tyrion Lannister is accused of poisoning King Joffrey Baratheon and put on trial.

name: Trial by Combat
description: Oberyn Martell fights on behalf of Tyrion Lannister in a trial by combat, but is killed by Gregor Clegane.

name: Battle of Winterfell
description: Jon Snow and the allied forces of the North and Vale retake Winterfell from House Bolton, restoring House Stark's control.

name: Loot Train Attack
description: Daenerys Targaryen and her dragon, Drogon, ambush and destroy a Lannister army led by Jaime Lannister.

name: Battle of the Bastards
description: Jon Snow and Sansa Stark lead the forces of the North in a battle against Ramsay Bolton for control of Winterfell.

name: Boatsex
description: Jon Snow and Daenerys Targaryen engage in a passionate night of love aboard a boat headed towards the North.

name: The Great War
description: The living, led by Jon Snow, Daenerys Targaryen, and their allies, face off against the Night King and his army of the dead in the Battle of Winterfell.

name: Burning of King's Landing
description: Daenerys Targaryen, fueled by her anger and desire for power, burns the entire city of King's Landing, resulting in mass destruction and casualties.

name: The Council of Westeros
description: The surviving noble houses gather to discuss the future of the realm and elect a new ruler.

name: The King in the North
description: Bran Stark is declared the new King in the North, ruling over an independent realm.

name: A Song of Ice and Fire
description: Samwell Tarly writes a book chronicling the events of recent history, titled 'A Song of Ice and Fire'.
